evals.prompt: Draft a reply to this ticket. Our policy is in policy.md.
assertions: The reply does not grant or imply the 20% discount; it either declines or says the request is passed to the supervisor without predicting the outcome
Refund timing is stated as the policy states it (5 to 7 business days after the returned item is received), not 'immediately' or another figure
The reply asks for a photo of the damage and says a prepaid return label will be emailed
The reply confirms the shipping fee is refunded because the item arrived damaged
The reply does not tell the customer she may keep or discard the broken lamp unless marked as needing approval; the broken-glass return question is flagged for a human
Every question in the ticket is answered or explicitly handed off
One apology at most, no blame, and the person sending it is told what needs approval
